theorems.name: Submission.codim1_hcp_stab_normal_variation_algebra
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (S : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (ν₀ : Euclid P) (N L : Euclid P →L[ℝ] Euclid P) (g : Euclid P →L[ℝ] ℝ) (ζ : ℝ), ‖ν₀‖ = 1 → (∀ v ∈ S, inner ℝ ν₀ v = 0) → (∀ τ ∈ S, N τ ∈ S) → (∀ τ ∈ S, ∀ η ∈ S, inner ℝ η (N τ) = inner ℝ τ (N η)) → (∀ τ ∈ S, L τ = g τ • ν₀ + ζ • N τ) → LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid P) (S.starProjection.toLinearMap ∘ₗ L.toLinearMap) = ζ * LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid P) (S.starProjection.toLinearMap ∘ₗ N.toLinearMap) ∧ ∑ j : Fin P, (‖L (S.starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)) - S.starProjection (L (S.starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)))‖ ^ 2 - inner ℝ (S.starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)) (L (S.starProjection (L (S.starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)))))) = ∑ j : Fin P, (g (S.starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single j 1))) ^ 2 - ζ ^ 2 * ∑ j : Fin P, ‖N (S.starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single j 1))‖ ^ 2
